answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Proof of unique EV charging history. It demands charging sessions at the same stations weekly, and the yarrow is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so charging sessions at the same stations weekly stays private; the comet is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The river is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
